name: JOINT STOCK COMPANY NATIONAL ATOMIC COMPANY KAZATOMPROM

announcements.headline: Statement from Kazatomprom’s Board of Directors
announcements.insight: The Board issued a statement following recent management changes and ESG improvements. Shareholders should monitor for further details on strategic direction.

announcements.headline: Kazatomprom 3Q26 Consolidated Financial Statements
announcements.insight: KAP publishes its 3Q26 consolidated financial statements. This follows recent ESG improvements and rating affirmations, providing updated performance data for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Kazatomprom Announces Management Change
announcements.insight: Kazatomprom announces a management change. This follows recent governance updates including an EGM and ESG score improvement.

announcements.headline: Official Statement from Kazatomprom
announcements.insight: KAP follows its recent ESG score improvement with an official statement. Shareholders should monitor for specific details regarding governance or operational updates.

announcements.headline: KAP Improves its S&P Global ESG Score
announcements.insight: KAP improves its ESG score, potentially supporting the stable credit outlooks affirmed by Fitch and Moody’s in August and September.

announcements.headline: Notice of the EGM of Shareholders
Voting results of the EGM of Shareholders
announcements.insight: KAP reported EGM voting results. This follows earlier August filings on financial results and rating affirmations.

announcements.headline: Expl rights for Kyzyltu,Update on Acid from Russia
announcements.insight: Kazatomprom updates on Kyzyltu rights and Russian acid supply. This follows recent operational and financial results, indicating ongoing project development.

announcements.headline: Moody’s affirms KAP’s Baa1 rating, Stable outlook
announcements.insight: KAP maintains its credit rating following a previous affirmation by Fitch in August. This confirms financial stability for bondholders without altering equity dynamics.

announcements.headline: Fitch Affirms KAP's Rating at BBB, Outlook Stable
announcements.insight: Fitch maintains KAP's BBB rating with a stable outlook. This follows recent bond coupon payments and financial results, confirming ongoing credit stability.

announcements.headline: Notice of the EGM of Kazatomprom
Kazatomprom announces 1H2026 Financial Results
announcements.insight: Kazatomprom announces 1H2026 Financial Results. This follows the 2Q26 Operations and Trading Update issued in August.

announcements.headline: Voting results of the EGM
announcements.insight: Kazatomprom reports EGM voting results regarding Board composition, following the June announcement. This confirms shareholder approval for the proposed board changes.

announcements.headline: Kazatomprom 2Q26 Operations and Trading Update
announcements.insight: Kazatomprom provides a trading update following its 1Q26 financial statements. This continues the routine operational reporting cycle for shareholders.

announcements.headline: KAP announces the payment of coupon on its bonds
announcements.insight: KAP announces a bond coupon payment. This follows earlier announcements regarding partial redemption of long-term bonds in June.

announcements.headline: Notice of GM
The EGM Results on the composition of the BoD
announcements.insight: Kazatomprom holds an EGM to determine Board composition. This follows May meetings approving dividends and reviewing FY2025 results.

announcements.headline: Report on Payments to Governments
Partial redemption of long-term bonds
announcements.insight: Kazatomprom redeemed long-term bonds following its FY2025 dividend approval. This capital action impacts shareholder returns and debt structure.

announcements.headline: Kazatomprom 1Q26 Consolidated Financial Statements
announcements.insight: Kazatomprom released its 1Q26 consolidated financial statements. This follows the May 2026 AGM and FY2025 dividend approval.

announcements.headline: Approval of dividends for the results of FY2025
announcements.insight: KAP has approved dividends for FY2025. Shareholders should monitor subsequent announcements regarding payment dates and ex-dividend details.

announcements.headline: Voting Results of the Annual General Meeting
announcements.insight: KAP shareholders should note the voting results of the Annual General Meeting. This confirms governance outcomes but lacks specific details on resolutions passed.
